title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Analista de processos
description:
Experiência com ferramentas de desenho de processos, experiencia comprovada.


  • Mapeamento de processos
  • Identificar e documentar fluxos de trabalho existentes.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como BPMN, fluxogramas e diagramas de processos.
  • Análise e diagnóstico
  • Avaliar gargalos, redundâncias e riscos nos processos.
  • Coletar dados de desempenho para identificar pontos de melhoria.
  • Proposição de melhorias
  • Sugerir soluções para otimizar tempo, reduzir custos e aumentar a qualidade.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de automação e transformação digital.
  • Implementação de mudanças
  • Acompanhar projetos de melhoria contínua.
  • Treinar equipes e garantir a adoção de novos processos.
  • Monitoramento e indicadores
  • Definir KPIs (indicadores-chave de desempenho).
  • Elaborar relatórios para acompanhar resultados e propor ajustes.
  • Conformidade e governança
  • Garantir que os processos estejam alinhados a normas internas e externas.
  • Apoiar auditorias e certificações (ISO, compliance, etc.).
  • Interação com áreas da empresa
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com TI, qualidade, operações e gestão.
  • Facilitar comunicação entre diferentes setores para integração de processos.

Perfil esperado

  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em metodologias de gestão de processos (BPM, Lean, Six Sigma).
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica.
  • Boa comunicação para conduzir workshops e treinamentos.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de melhoria contínua.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Analytics Engineer (Pleno)
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores. 28 anos de história e 15x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW). Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um Analytics Engineer (Pleno), confira as informações da vaga:


Descrição da Vaga

Atuar no desenvolvimento e otimização de pipelines de dados e soluções analíticas escaláveis , transformando dados brutos em insights estratégicos para o negócio . Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multifuncionais para garantir qualidade, acessibilidade e usabilidade dos dados , promovendo uma cultura data-driven na organização.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Realizar modelagem de dados para atender às necessidades específicas dos times de negócio.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders para compreender demandas e desenvolver produtos de dados (pipelines, indicadores e dashboards) com foco no usuário final.
  • Desenvolver datasets que servirão como fonte única da verdade da empresa , seguindo a arquitetura Medallion (Gold/Diamond) .
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas fontes e plataformas, propondo e implementando soluções automatizadas.
  • Implementar melhorias em processos internos por meio da disponibilização de dados e datasets escaláveis .
  • Atuar como defensor do valor de negócio dos dados , oferecendo orientação técnica e soluções para desafios estratégicos.
  • Construir, manter e evoluir pipelines analíticos com a abordagem de dados como produto , desde o dado bruto até o dado ouro, pronto para consumo por algoritmos e réguas de comunicação.
  • Monitorar a saúde, qualidade e performance da infraestrutura analítica , realizando otimizações contínuas.
  • Desenvolver análises, visualizações, gráficos e dashboards a partir da infraestrutura de dados implementada.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e de infraestrutura em projetos técnicos e evolutivos.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência na escrita de queries em SQL, Python e/ou R , com foco em performance e escalabilidade .
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização e análise de dados , como Looker, Power BI ou similares.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e analíticos , como BigQuery e Redshift .


Interessou?

Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte de um time que valoriza técnica, protagonismo e impacto real nas soluções!

title: Senior NodeJS Developer
description:
Senior Node.js Developer

Location: Brazil (preferred)

Contract / Contract-to-Hire | Immediate Start

We’re looking for a Senior Node.js Developer to join a fast-growing engineering team working on regulated financial platforms across LATAM.


This is an urgent, high-impact hire. You’ll be joining at a critical stage, helping to deliver key product milestones and scale secure, high-availability systems in a regulated environment.

If you enjoy ownership, autonomy, and building systems that genuinely matter - this role is for you.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and scaling backend services using Node.js
  • Deploying and managing applications in Kubernetes
  • Working with MongoDB in production environments
  • Contributing to cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS)
  • Identifying technical risks and proactively solving them
  • Collaborating closely with product and engineering stakeholders


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js (essential)
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments
  • Solid knowledge of MongoDB
  • Experience with Azure or AWS (nice to have)
  • Comfortable working in regulated or high-availability environments


More importantly, we’re looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership
  • Communicates clearly
  • Thinks ahead and manages risk
  • Works independently
  • Thrives in fast-paced teams


Experience in Financial Services, Open Finance, or Banking is a plus.

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location: Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Clinical Statistical Programmer to join our team in Brazil. The ideal candidate will play a key role in supporting clinical trial data standardization, statistical analysis, and regulatory submissions. This position requires strong expertise in SAS programming, CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), and the development of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs).

Key Responsibilities

  • Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets
  • Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions
  • Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting
  • Develop reusable Python or R scripts to support automation, validation, and reproducible reporting
  • Perform programming quality control (QC) and peer reviews to ensure accuracy, traceability, and compliance
  • Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated CRFs
  • Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues
  • Support audits and regulatory inspections by ensuring reproducible code and complete documentation

Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with SAS programming
  • Solid expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)
  • Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions
  • In-depth knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes
  • Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent documentation practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions to agencies such as the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the European Medicines Agency (EMA)
  • Prior experience in a Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer (Founding Architect)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Our partner is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to serve as their founding infrastructure expert. You will be responsible for evaluating the needs and designing a modern, scalable, and automated AWS environment from scratch. We are looking for a strategic thinker who understands the trade-offs between various deployment models and can lead them toward the best long-term solution.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Greenfield Architecture: Evaluate, recommend, and implement the optimal infrastructure strategy (e.g., Kubernetes/EKS vs. ECS/Fargate vs. Serverless) based on our Python-heavy workload.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Build and maintain our entire AWS stack using IaC tools (Terraform or Pulumi).
  • CI/CD Ownership: Design and manage automated deployment pipelines that empower our developers to ship code safely and frequently.
  • Security & Monitoring: Establish best practices for IAM, VPC networking, and comprehensive observability (logging/alerting).
  • Global Collaboration: Work remotely with a distributed team, maintaining core availability during Pacific Time (PT) hours.


Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • AWS Expert: Deep experience across the AWS ecosystem with the ability to justify architectural choices.
  • Proven \"Builder\" Track Record: Experience setting up production environments from nothing.
  • Python Proficiency: Strong scripting skills for automation and integration.
  • Remote Fluency: Highly organized and capable of working effectively in a global, remote-first environment.


Work Schedule:  Overlap with PST working hours


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to work with a fast-growing company driving digital transformation for legal practices.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team and grow long-term.

title: Analista de Automação - CAWA (Remoto)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Automação de Workload especializado em CA Workload Automation (CAWA) com experiência em automação de processos e habilidades técnicas para gerenciar e otimizar workloads através da plataforma CAWA.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Gerenciamento de Workloads: Planejar, implementar e monitorar processos automatizados utilizando CAWA;
  • Análise de Performance: Executar análises contínuas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria na automação de tarefas;
  • Suporte Técnico: Fornecer suporte técnico e orientação para a equipe em relação a problemas relacionados ao CAWA;
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em conjunto com outras equipes para garantir a integração eficaz de sistemas e processos;
  • Documentação: Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre processos e procedimentos de automação.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Formação: Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência com CA Workload Automation, com domínio nas funcionalidades da ferramenta;
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento em scripting (e.g., Python, Bash) e experiência com bancos de dados;
  • Capacidade Analítica: Habilidade para analisar problemas complexos e propor soluções eficazes.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de Dono;
  • Foco no Cliente.

title: SDR/BDR
description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR/BDR – Remote Role)


Stealth Manager is looking for a motivated and results-driven Sales Development Representative (SDR/BDR) to join our growing team! This is a fully remote position under the PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) contract model.


Working Hours: Monday to Friday, from 9:45 AM to 7:00 PM (BRT)

Fluent English is required


Main Responsibilities

  • Identify, qualify, and develop new sales opportunities through a combination of inbound and outbound strategies .
  • Proactively prospect new business through outbound channels such as LinkedIn, cold email, and outbound messaging.
  • Manage and respond to inbound leads and messages from platforms such as LinkedIn and Meta, maintaining professional and persuasive communication.
  • Build and manage prospect lists using CRM systems and outreach automation tools.
  • Actively operate and optimize LinkedIn and other outreach automation platforms to generate and re-engage leads.
  • Qualify prospects based on fit, needs, and potential, and schedule meetings for the sales team.
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to generate qualified opportunities and support the sales pipeline.
  • Maintain accurate records of all activities, follow-ups, and communications in the CRM system.
  • Test and optimize messaging, sequences, and prospecting strategies to continuously improve results.
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas to improve lead generation and sales processes.
  • Stay up to date with market trends, sales development best practices, and outreach strategies.


The Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • Previous experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR) , Business Development Representative (BDR) , or in a similar sales development role.
  • Proven, hands-on experience using outreach automation platforms (especially LinkedIn or similar tools) on a daily basis.
  • Real experience actively operating automation tools (not just familiarity).
  • Experience working with marketing agencies or within the marketing sector.
  • Ability to handle both inbound and outbound conversations with prospects in a professional and persuasive way.
  • Strong prospecting, qualification, and follow-up skills.
  • Strong ability to schedule and manage sales calls with qualified prospects.
  • Fluent written English and advanced conversational English.
  • Experience managing leads, pipelines, and follow-ups using CRM systems.


What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere: 100% remote work to balance your professional and personal life.
  • Development and Growth: Continuous learning opportunities, including a partnership with Open English and personalized development plans.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Monthly performance-based variable bonuses and paid vacations.
  • Culture of Innovation: An environment that values new ideas, teamwork, and individual contributions toward shared goals.


Join Us

Stealth Manager is a leading digital marketing agency, recognized for its creative and effective white-label solutions for the U.S. market. But what is white-label marketing? It’s a model where we offer tailored marketing services to partner agencies, allowing them to resell our services as their own—ensuring excellent delivery while strengthening their brands.

In 2024, we achieved an impressive 300% growth, reinforcing our commitment to exceptional results and successful partnerships. We operate across more than 70 niches, fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment focused on teamwork and results.

At Stealth, we deeply value people. We believe that a happy and motivated team is the key to high-performance outcomes. Our culture is guided by the motto \"Work Smart and Be Nice\" — we combine smart work with kindness in our relationships, creating an environment where freedom and responsibility go hand in hand to drive both professional and personal growth.

  • Join our team and help turn challenges into success stories!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic & Video Content Designer

We are building a fast-growing brand in the health and wellness industry and are looking for a strategic, creative, and performance-driven Graphic & Video Content Designer .

This is a key position within the company, with direct impact on sales, brand positioning, and growth.

If you thrive in a dynamic environment, handle a high volume of projects, and enjoy creative responsibility, this opportunity is for you.

Responsibilities

• Create high-impact graphic and video content for paid ads, social media, email marketing, website, and marketplaces

• Develop creative concepts aligned with marketing strategy and conversion goals

• Produce short-form videos optimized for TikTok, Instagram, Meta Ads, and Amazon

• Prepare and finalize print-ready files for production, ensuring proper bleed, safety margins, color profiles, and print standards

• Develop technical files for packaging, labels, and promotional materials

• Ensure quality control before production

• Maintain brand consistency across all platforms

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines with organization and attention to detail

Requirements

• Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in Graphic Design and/or Video Editing

• Hands-on experience preparing print-ready files and packaging materials

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

• Proven experience with CorelDRAW

• Strong understanding of color profiles, CMYK, RGB, resolution, and print production standards

• Strong portfolio showcasing real projects, preferably performance-driven and e-commerce focused

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

• High level of organization and attention to detail

Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred, but portfolio and proven experience carry greater weight.

What We Offer

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience


Mandatory: Please include a portfolio link showcasing both graphic and video projects. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

• Opportunity to grow within a fast-expanding brand

• Dynamic and challenging environment

• Strategic projects with direct business impact

• Competitive compensation based on experience

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
Want to put your job search on autopilot? Join our platform, complete a 6-minute AI screening interview, and get auto-applied to 100s of high-paying roles.

Sign up now at and let the opportunities come to you.

About the Role

We are seeking a Frontend Engineer to design and develop sophisticated interfaces that empower developers to interact with its AI and blockchain infrastructure. This individual will play a key role in building intuitive dashboards, monitoring tools, and prototypes on top of the Ritual chain, making complex distributed systems more accessible and manageable.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing and implementing transaction monitoring interfaces that visualize the complete lifecycle across our infrastructure, including broker status, node operations, and cross-chain interactions.
  • Building and maintaining dashboard interfaces for node deployment, monitoring, and management across cloud providers.
  • Developing web applications that enable users to provision and manage customized node infrastructure through intuitive interfaces.
  • Creating responsive dashboards for real-time monitoring of distributed compute resources and container management.
  • Designing and implementing DeFi-style interfaces for protocol interactions, similar to DEX and vault management experiences.
  • Collaborating closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver seamless user experiences.
  • Participating in code reviews and providing constructive feedback to team members.
  • Writing efficient, high-quality code aligned with our standards for user experience.


About the Candidate

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • A strong foundation in HTML/CSS, TypeScript, and React.
  • Significant experience productionizing user interfaces for decentralized applications that directly interact with EVM-based blockchains.
  • Proficiency with Web3 wallet integration libraries (wagmi, ethers, etc.) and blockchain interaction patterns.
  • Full-stack expertise with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues across the frontend and backend, including familiarity with API design and server-side architectures.
  • Comfort with Linux and command-line environments for development and debugging.
  • Experience creating responsive monitoring dashboards and data visualization interfaces.
  • Knowledge of state management patterns and real-time data handling.
  • A strong understanding of cross-chain transaction flows and blockchain infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend build tools and deployment pipelines.
  • The ability to perform well under pressure, adapt quickly to shifting priorities, and maintain a high level of ownership and self-direction.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive, energetic approach to problem-solving.


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing multi-platform applications (web, desktop, mobile).
  • Background in building interfaces for distributed systems or node management.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure monitoring and management.
  • Knowledge of container orchestration and cloud provider interfaces.
  • Experience with Electron or similar desktop application frameworks.
  • Understanding of GraphQL and real-time data subscriptions.
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the Web3 ecosystem.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h.

title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM
description:
Title: ServiceNow Developer with Strategic Portfolio Management(SPM) & ITSM

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Job Specific Responsibilities:

● Have the ability to assist requesters in refining business requirement details to ensure the customers will be receiving functionality requested.

● Gain knowledge of our overall ServiceNow implementation to understand and identify cross platform impacts of changes or enhancements being requested.

● Design, develop, and implement SPM solutions including workflows, catalog items, workspaces, and integrations to meet complex business requirements

● Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using javascript and ServiceNow APIs to extend capabilities and enhance user experience

● Design and implement workflows to support business needs and increase automation

● Develop and configure integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems using integration spokes or custom APIs

● Work within the Agile methodology to develop, build and test alongside other developers to ensure the best product is delivered to requestors in a timely manner

● Work with implementation partners, or internal project teams to Implement new modules as business needs evolve

● Assist with regular ServiceNow version upgrades to ensure we remain compliant and supported by the vendor

Key Skills, Requirements and Competencies:

● Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or a relevant technical field

● At least 3+ years experience working with the ServiceNow platform, specifically in the SPM module, and with good familiarity with ITSM, and the general ServiceNow platform

● Strong understanding of ITIL principles and practices

● Proficiency in JavaScript and ServiceNow API web services

● Proven experience with integrating ServiceNow with other applications

● Excellent analytical and problem solving skills

● Effective communication and interpersonal skills

Thanks

Aatmesh

title: Team Lead - PIM
description:
Tidal is a forward-thinking company specializing in delivering innovative technology solutions that empower businesses to optimize their product information management. Our dynamic environment fosters collaboration across diverse teams, focusing on scalable and high-quality data solutions to drive business success. This remote role offers the opportunity to lead a skilled PIM team in leveraging the inRiver platform to enhance product information workflows.
Job Responsibilities
  • Lead and mentor the inRiver PIM/ any PIM implementation and support team, ensuring effective collaboration and continuous skill development.
  • Drive the design and deployment of scalable PIM solutions that meet business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Ensure robust data governance, maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity of product information.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, product management, and marketing, to align PIM initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Oversee troubleshooting and resolution of PIM-related issues to minimize downtime and optimize system performance.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for PIM processes, standards, and configurations.
  • Stay updated on the latest inRiver PIM platform features and industry trends to continuously improve solution delivery.
Required Qualifications
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with the PIM platform (preferably - inRiver PIM System)
  • Proven leadership experience in managing technical teams within Product Information Management.
  • Advanced to fluent English proficiency with excellent communication skills.
  • College degree in a relevant field; Master’s degree or higher is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data governance principles and PIM best practices.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in a remote, distributed team environment.
  • Background in IT services or technology consulting sectors.
  • Certifications related to PIM or project management.
  • Familiarity with other PIM platforms or complementary digital commerce technologies.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Join Avanto - A Leader in the Furniture Industry!


About Avanto:

Avanto is an innovative and forward-thinking company transforming the furniture industry through technology and a people-centric approach. We stand out for our cutting-edge solutions, exceptional service, and strong commitment to excellence, integrity, and innovation.


At Avanto, we foster an environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally, promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and a results-driven culture. Our mission is to make a positive impact on the industry by driving change and continuous improvement.


Role Summary:

Serve as the primary point of contact for ensuring smooth service transitions and maintaining high customer satisfaction post-go-live. This role focuses on monitoring service quality, managing risks, and driving continuous improvement through customer insights.


Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Experience & Quality Assurance o Monitor customer feedback and satisfaction metrics. o Oversee service transition from PMO to Service Managers and ensure expectations are met. o Track SLA adherence and identify risks during the first 30–90 days post-launch.

2. Escalation & Risk Management o Respond to urgent issues and maintain escalation logs. o Maintain a risk register and implement preventive measures.

3. Continuous Improvement & Insights o Audit customer interactions to identify trends and improvement opportunities. o Share insights with teams and recommend workflow or process enhancements.

4. Knowledge Management o Maintain and update a centralized knowledge base (FAQs, best practices). o Ensure customer-facing documentation is accurate and complete.

5. Customer Advocacy o Organize periodic feedback sessions or surveys. o Relay feature requests and usability concerns to product teams.


Ideal Professional Profiles

• Customer Success Specialists – Experienced in post-onboarding support and customer satisfaction.

• Service Delivery Coordinators – Skilled in managing service transitions and SLA adherence.

• Operations Analysts – Familiar with process improvement and risk management.

• Project Support Officers – With exposure to PMO handoffs and service continuity.


Years of Experience

• 2–4 years in customer success, service delivery, or operational support roles.

• Entry-level candidates with 1–2 years experience in customer-facing roles may be considered if they have strong analytical and communication skills.

• Mid-level candidates (3–5 years) preferred for handling escalations and continuous improvement initiatives.


Educational & Professional Background

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).

• Experience in: o Customer experience management and quality assurance. o Risk management and SLA monitoring. o Knowledge base maintenance and documentation.


Additional Skills to Highlight

• Strong communication and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to interpret customer feedback and drive actionable improvements.

title: Especialista de Implantação SAP PY
description:
Na ADP, somos movidos pelo seu sucesso. Envolvemos seus talentos e perspectivas únicos. Acolhemos suas ideias para fazer as coisas de modo diferente e melhor. Nós apoiamos seus esforços para realizar, aprender e crescer. Se o sucesso te motiva, você pertence à ADP.

Nos esforçamos para que cada interação seja motivada pelos nossos valores CENTRAIS: Conhecimento e Visão, Integridade é Tudo, Excelência na Prestação de Serviços, Inovação Inspiradora, Cada Pessoa Conta, Orientação a Resultados e Responsabilidade Social.

Nossa cultura acolhe diversas perspectivas e cria um lugar onde as carreiras podem florescer. Nós respeitamos e valorizamos as diferenças com oportunidades iguais de emprego, independentemente de raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade, cultura, deficiência ou status social.

Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso. Faça parte do nosso time!

RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO


Como Consultor SAP, você atuará como facilitador entre a equipe de implementação e os clientes para entender melhor suas necessidades de negócios.

Atuará também como mentor ou treinador de parceiros. Preparará especificações funcionais, incluindo detalhes sobre design e configuração.

FUNÇÕES:


  • Resolver os problemas reportados nos SLAs.
  • Configuração do SAP HCM PY para folha de pagamento Brasil, Argentina, Colombia e Costa Rica
  • Fornecer aos clientes o status das implementações
  • Guarde a documentação do cliente
  • Fornecer suporte a aplicativos
  • Reunir-se com clientes sempre que necessário
  • Aplicar conhecimento funcional relevante específico do país para potencializar o serviço focado no cliente
  • Realizar testes unitários
  • Fornecer documentação

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em implementação SAP HCM, módulo de folha de pagamento (PY)
  • Ensino superior completo
  • Inglês em nível avançado para conversação


O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.”

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Suporte Pleno com foco em SRE e Cloud para atuar na sustentação, evolução e confiabilidade de ambientes críticos em nuvem. Essa pessoa terá papel ativo na estabilidade de sistemas produtivos, atuando desde o monitoramento e automação até a análise e resolução de incidentes, sempre em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança.

  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de ambientes Cloud (AWS, Microsoft Azure e/ou Google Cloud Platform)

  • Automatizar processos operacionais como deploys, rotinas, escalabilidade e correções
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e segurança
  • Propor melhorias contínuas visando maior resiliência, performance e redução de incidentes
  • Atuar em regime de plantão conforme escala 24x7

  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos atuando com suporte, SRE, Cloud ou áreas correlatas

  • Conhecimento sólido em Kubernetes e containers (Docker)
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Grafana, Zabbix, Datadog, New Relic, Elastic, Dynatrace ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux
  • Experiência com troubleshooting de aplicações e infraestrutura
  • Noções de redes, balanceamento de carga e alta disponibilidade

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)
description:
Job Title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location - Brazil


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.

Key Responsibilities

· Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

· Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

· Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

· Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

· Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

· Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated


CRFs

· Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

· Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation


Required Qualifications

· Strong experience with SAS programming

· Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

· Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

· Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

· Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

· Strong attention to detail and documentation practices


Preferred

· Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

· Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment


Interested candidates please share your profiles to

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Sobre o Colab

O Colab é uma empresa que conecta a população ao governo, dando mais voz ao cidadão e proporcionando uma gestão pública mais colaborativa . 

Operamos no modelo SaaS (Software as a Service), disponibilizando uma plataforma de gerenciamento de serviços omnichannel , ou seja, que centraliza todos os atendimentos ao cidadão, via aplicativo/website do colab e integrações (como WhatsApp).

O produto do Colab pode ser dividido em diversas frentes, porém nosso público prioritário são os gestores de prefeituras municipais. Para eles, somos um canal para melhorar o relacionamento com o munícipe e uma plataforma para disponibilizar os serviços da prefeitura na palma da mão do cidadão (via aplicativo), colhendo informações que servem como respaldo para as ações e planejamentos municipais e promovem a gestão transparente .

Aqui, a tecnologia escala nosso propósito. Somos movidos pela inovação tecnológica para gerar alto impacto positivo na sociedade, atuando como sinônimo de soluções simplificadas para a coisa pública.


Objetivo

Como Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior, você terá o desafio de arquitetar e desenvolver soluções que transformem a gestão pública. Você não apenas escreverá código, mas ajudará a \"resolver problemas complexos a partir de soluções criativas e sustentáveis\" e pensamento “AI first”.

Seu trabalho impactará diretamente a vida de outras pessoas, desenvolvendo produtos com afeto e método. Você atuará na modernização da nossa stack, integrando Inteligência Artificial para co-criar uma gestão pública fluida e eficiente.

Desafios e responsabilidades

  • Atuar em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (end-to-end) utilizando metodologia SCRUM, garantindo entregas ágeis e de valor.
  • Projetar e manter arquiteturas escaláveis em AWS, com forte uso de Serverless (Lambdas) e serviços gerenciados.
  • Liderar a implementação de funcionalidades baseadas em Inteligência Artificial Generativa, utilizando preferencialmente AWS Bedrock, para criar soluções preditivas e assistivas para o cidadão e o gestor público.
  • Desenvolver interfaces ricas e performáticas com React/Next.js e TypeScript, integradas a backends robustos em Node.js ou Python.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar consultas em bancos de dados relacionais (RDS Postgres) e não relacionais (MongoDB).
  • Ser uma referência técnica para o time. No Colab, trocamos informação de forma aberta e estendemos a mão para ajudar, pois nunca erramos sozinhos.

title: TechOps Specialist (HL7 Integration)
description:
TechOps (HL7 Integration)


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing healthcare SaaS organization, is seeking a Technical Operations Specialist to support post-sales technical implementations and system integrations.

This role is responsible for configuring and deploying HL7 interfaces within client environments, ensuring secure and accurate data connectivity between the SaaS platform and customer systems. The ideal candidate understands healthcare data workflows, integration standards, and how to work cross-functionally with client IT teams to enable seamless interoperability.

This is a post-sales, client-facing technical role that blends implementation, troubleshooting, and systems integration.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in healthcare IT, technical operations, or systems integration
  • Direct experience working with HL7 interfaces (v2.x preferred)
  • Experience connecting SaaS platforms to EHR or clinical systems
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures and workflows
  • Experience working with APIs, endpoints, or secure data transmission protocols
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently
  • Strong communication skills when working with client IT teams


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within a healthcare SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with EHR systems
  • Experience with interface engines
  • Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant data handling practices


Key Responsibilities


Post-Sales Implementation Support

  • Lead technical onboarding activities following customer contract execution
  • Configure and deploy HL7 interfaces within client instances
  • Coordinate with client IT and EHR teams to establish secure data connections
  • Ensure accurate mapping of inbound and outbound data fields

HL7 & Data Integration

  • Build, configure, and validate HL7 message interfaces
  • Support integration between the SaaS platform and client EHR or clinical systems
  • Troubleshoot data transmission errors and interface failures
  • Validate endpoint connectivity and message formatting

Client Collaboration

  • Serve as technical point of contact during implementation
  • Communicate integration requirements clearly to client technical stakeholders
  • Assist in diagnosing and resolving integration-related issues
  • Support go-live and stabilization efforts

System & Workflow Optimization

  • Monitor integration performance and data accuracy
  • Improve documentation around interface setup and troubleshooting
  • Contribute to process improvements within the technical operations function

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior (Flutter e .Net)
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior com forte atuação em backend .NET e experiência sólida em Flutter para atuar em projetos estratégicos, com participação ativa nas decisões técnicas e arquitetura das soluções.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços backend utilizando .NET (Core / .NET 6+)
  • Construir aplicações web e/ou mobile com Flutter
  • Projetar e implementar integrações entre frontend e backend
  • Garantir boas práticas de arquitetura, segurança e performance
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e definição de arquitetura
  • Realizar code review e contribuir com a qualidade do código
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, UX e QA
  • Apoiar troubleshooting e investigações técnicas em produção

title: Vendas
description:
Sobre a Vaga:


Estamos buscando um(a) Chatter focado(a) em vendas , responsável por:

  • Atender clientes via chat
  • Criar conexão e relacionamento estratégico
  • Identificar oportunidades de venda
  • Trabalhar funil de conversão
  • Executar metas diárias e semanais
  • Aplicar scripts e personalizar abordagem
  • Registrar métricas e resultados

Aqui, atendimento = vendas.

Não é suporte passivo.



Perfil que buscamos:


  • Perfil vendedor (gosta de meta e comissão)
  • Comunicação persuasiva
  • Escrita rápida e natural
  • Disciplina e organização
  • Consegue trabalhar com volume alto de mensagens
  • Não procrastina
  • Mentalidade de crescimento

    • Diferencial:


    • Experiência com vendas online
    • Experiência com copywriting
    • Experiência com atendimento digital


    Modelo de reumneração:


    • Fixo mensal
    • Comissão sobre vendas
    • Bônus por metas semanais
    • Bônus por metas mensais
    • Plano de crescimento interno

    (Se quiser, posso estruturar essa parte já bem estratégica para gerar mais atração.)


    Modelo de trabalho:


    • 100% remoto
    • Turnos definidos
    • Metas claras
    • Acompanhamento de performance


    Cultura Secrets:


    Aqui valorizamos:

    • Performance
    • Velocidade
    • Execução
    • Clareza
    • Comunicação direta
    • Mentalidade de dono

    Se você busca estabilidade sem cobrança, essa vaga não é para você.


    Como se candidatar:


    Candidate-se pelo formulário e aguarde as próximas etapas do processo seletivo.

title: Engenheiro de Exchange
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.



O que buscamos?

  • Especialista em Microsoft Exchange (On-Premises & Online) com foco em Segurança.


Principais responsabilidades técnicas:

  • Migração de Exchange On-Premises para Microsoft Exchange Online
  • Projetos e upgrades de Microsoft Exchange Server (2010, 2013, 2016, 2019)
  • Configuração híbrida, fluxo de e-mail (SMTP), DAG, alta disponibilidade e disaster recovery
  • Configuração de MX apontando para EOP ou gateways de terceiros
  • Scripting avançado em PowerShell
  • Health checks, troubleshooting avançado e recomendações de boas práticas


Infraestrutura & Identidade:

  • Arquitetura e administração de Active Directory (2008/2016)
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes on-premises
  • Cluster de Failover
  • Experiência comprovada em múltiplos projetos (mín. 5 anos em arquitetura, implantação e suporte)


Segurança e Compliance (diferencial importante):

  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (políticas de higiene de e-mail, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Threat Explorer, Quarantine, Advanced Hunting)
  • Microsoft Purview (retenção, rótulos de sensibilidade, DLP, eDiscovery; diferenciais: Insider Risk, Information Barriers e Communication Compliance)



CLT FULL + Benefícios

Contrato híbrido para **eventuais** viagens e visitas a cliente.


O que oferecemos?


· Contratação CLT;

· Vale Refeição;

· Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

· Auxílio creche;

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

· Seguro de Vida.



“O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).”

title: Fotográfo(a)
description:
Vaga: Fotógrafo(a)

Empresa: TOQ

Modelo: Prestador de Serviços (PJ)

Formato: Externo / Home Office (edição)

Local de atuação: Alphaville – Barueri/SP e região

SOBRE A TOQ

A TOQ é uma startup que atua no mercado imobiliário de Alphaville, conectando proprietários de imóveis a corretores e imobiliárias por meio de uma plataforma inteligente, organizada e eficiente.

SOBRE A VAGA

Buscamos um(a) Fotógrafo(a) para atuar como prestador de serviços (PJ), de forma externa, realizando captação de imagens em imóveis anunciados na plataforma da TOQ.


O profissional não precisa comparecer presencialmente à empresa. A rotina envolve deslocamento até os imóveis para captação do material e edição realizada em home office, conforme agenda organizada pela equipe interna.

O contrato prevê atendimento de até 80 imóveis por mês , dentro de um formato fechado e padronizado de entrega (pacote de fotos + vídeo curto).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Realizar sessões fotográficas de imóveis residenciais e comerciais;
  • Captar imagens com excelente enquadramento, iluminação e composição;
  • Produzir vídeo curto padronizado do imóvel, conforme modelo da TOQ;
  • Realizar edição e tratamento das fotos e vídeos conforme padrão visual estabelecido;
  • Entregar os materiais dentro dos prazos acordados;
  • Zelar pela organização e cuidado com o imóvel durante as captações;
  • Seguir orientações de quantidade de fotos, enquadramento e padrão de entrega;
  • Manter comunicação clara e alinhada com o time responsável pelos agendamentos.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Residir próximo à região de Alphaville (Barueri ou Santana de Parnaíba);
  • Possuir carro ou moto próprios para deslocamento;
  • Equipamentos próprios para fotografia e captação de vídeo;
  • Disponibilidade para agenda dinâmica na região;
  • Organização, pontualidade e responsabilidade com prazos.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Experiência prévia com fotografia imobiliária, interiores ou arquitetura;
  • Conhecimento em edição de vídeo;
  • Agilidade operacional para alto volume de demandas;
  • Sensibilidade estética e atenção aos detalhes.


PERFIL PROFISSIONAL

  • Atuação autônoma e responsável;
  • Compromisso com qualidade e consistência de entrega;
  • Boa postura profissional em campo, especialmente no contato com proprietários;
  • Capacidade de seguir padrões técnicos e operacionais estabelecidos pela TOQ;
  • Organização para lidar com volume mensal recorrente de imóveis.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Position: Software Engineer (.NET/C#)

Contract Length: 12-month contract + extensions

Location: Remote (EST hours)

*This is a PJ contract opportunity working 40 hours a week*


Must Haves:

● 3-5+ years of coding experience in C#, ASP.NET and related languages

● Experience with Bitbucket/Github and Jira

● Working knowledge of database and storage such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, etc

● Optimizing SQL call performance.

● C1 or C2 level English


Plusses:

● Experience in React.

● Experience/knowledge within retail, ecommerce or Product Lifecycle Management systems (ideally Bamboo Rose)

Seeking an innovator in the design and development of C# software and applications for retail platforms, backend systems and databases. We operate using the principles of Agile.


Compensation:

$15/hr to $25/hr USD.


Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC) ||  Brazil
description:
Role :: Clinical Statistical Programmer (SAS / CDISC)

Location :: Brazil/Remote

Duration :: Long Term Contract


Role Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Clinical Statistical Programmer to support clinical trial data standardization, analysis, and regulatory submissions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM), SAS programming, and generation of Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), along with experience in quality control and submission readiness.


Key Responsibilities

• Transform raw clinical trial data into CDISC-compliant SDTM and ADaM datasets

• Develop, validate, and maintain Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs) for clinical study reports and regulatory submissions

• Write efficient, well-documented SAS programs for data cleaning, derivations, and reporting

• Develop reusable Python or R scripts for automation, validation, and reproducible reporting

• Perform programming QC and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and traceability

• Prepare and maintain programming specifications, mapping documents, and annotated CRFs

• Troubleshoot complex data integration and derivation issues

• Support audits and regulatory inspections with reproducible code and documentation

Required Qualifications

• Strong experience with SAS programming

• Hands-on experience with CDISC standards (SDTM & ADaM)

• Experience generating TLFs for regulatory submissions

• Knowledge of clinical trial data structures and submission processes

• Familiarity with Python or R for automation (preferred)

• Strong attention to detail and documentation practices

Preferred

• Experience supporting FDA/EMA regulatory submissions

• Prior experience in a Pharma, Biotech, or CRO environment

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
Senior Media Buyer (Lead Generation & Patient Acquisition) | 100% remote


About the Role

We are hiring a senior-level performance marketer to own strategy, execution, and optimization of multi-account paid media campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking for local healthcare providers. This is a hands-on, high-accountability role managing complex campaign portfolios across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

This position is best suited for operators who are deeply analytical, comfortable managing scale, and experienced in service-based lead generation (not ecommerce).


What You Will Own

  • Full-funnel paid media strategy for local lead generation campaigns
  • Campaign build, optimization, and scaling across multiple client accounts
  • Budget allocation, audience strategy, creative testing, and performance improvement
  • Lead quality analysis and conversion performance optimization
  • Performance reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations
  • Continuous testing of messaging, offers, and conversion drivers


Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years managing Meta Ads AND Google Ads professionally
  • Proven experience generating leads for local or service-based businesses
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Hands-on optimization experience focused on CPL and conversion quality
  • Experience with appointment-based funnels (consultations, bookings, or patient acquisition)
  • Strong analytical decision-making based on performance data


Strongly Preferred

  • Healthcare or chiropractic marketing experience
  • Experience managing 15+ accounts concurrently
  • Advanced understanding of local advertising and geographic targeting
  • Experience working in agency environments
  • Clear, professional spoken English for client-adjacent collaboration

title: ServiceNow Technical Architect
description:
ServiceNow Technical Architect


Start Date: ASAP

End Date: Aug 28, 2026

100% remote

English and Portuguese are required

Candidates from LATAM


We are seeking a true Technical Architect (not a developer/consultant) to lead and drive developers in a CSM workstream. This role is the technical leader responsible for designing, building, and maintaining ServiceNow’s unified customer engagement platform (NOW Engage), serving Expert Services and Partner consultants globally.


The Technical Architect translates business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions, ensures platform integrity and performance, and provides hands‑on technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with best practices.
  • Lead architecture for multi‑tenant NOW Engage, ensuring security, data isolation, and performance.
  • Architect integrations with external systems (REST APIs, Integration Hub, AI/GenAI features).
  • Guide scrum teams, oversee code reviews, and enforce technical standards.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, executives, and cross‑functional teams to align business and technical goals.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards, security, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Drive continuous improvement through monitoring, automation, CI/CD, and documentation.


Requirements:

  • 6–10+ years of ServiceNow experience (development, administration, architecture).
  • Deep knowledge of ServiceNow products (CSM, SPM, ITSM, ITOM).
  • Expertise in custom app development, advanced data models, workflows, and API integrations.
  • Strong coding skills (JavaScript, REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, UI Builder).
  • Experience with multi‑tenant architecture, scalability, and performance optimization.
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.


Preferred

  • ServiceNow CTA, CIS, or CAD certifications.
  • Experience with AI/GenAI integrations and Agile/SAFe methodologies.
  • Leadership of scrum teams and collaboration with external vendors.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps.


Key Attributes

  • Architectural thinking and problem‑solving.
  • Strong technical leadership and quality focus.
  • Executive presence with excellent communication skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in dynamic environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25% annually.

title: SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant
description:
SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant (PTD/Warehousing)

Global Transformation Program – Remote (Brazil)

Contract: 12 months


Job Description

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Consultant with a strong focus on PTD (Plan-to-Deliver) and Warehousing to support a global greenfield S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC).


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define data requirements aligned to standardized value stream processes.
  • Translate business process designs into master and transactional data structures for SAP S/4HANA.
  • Support global template design ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and hierarchies.
  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return).

Functional Process Data Ownership

  • Define data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.
  • Support business rules, validations, and derivations.
  • Align data structures with SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, harmonization, and validation activities.
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems (ECC) to S/4HANA.
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, reconciliations, and cutover readiness.
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to go-live.

Data Governance & Standards

  • Support establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.
  • Collaborate with Master Data and Data Governance teams.
  • Help define data ownership, stewardship, and governance models.
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.
  • Provide post-go-live stabilization and hypercare support.


Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield implementations preferred).
  • Proven experience in large-scale, global ERP transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of value stream processes and related data objects.
  • Solid background in data migration, cleansing, conversion, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (Material, Vendor/Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).
  • Understanding of ECC to S/4HANA data model changes.
  • Experience with master data management and governance concepts.
  • Familiarity with data migration tools (SAP Migration Cockpit, ETL tools, LVM).
  • Ability to interpret functional specifications, data models, and technical table structures.
  • Experience with enterprise asset hierarchies and master data modeling.
  • Master data and indirect materials experience required.
  • Profisee Software experience required.
  • Experience with Promethius Asset Workbench is highly desirable (not mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.
  • Prior experience as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools, metrics, and governance frameworks.

  • Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return).

Functional Process Data Ownership

  • Define data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.
  • Support business rules, validations, and derivations.
  • Align data structures with SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

  • Support data cleansing, enrichment, harmonization, and validation activities.
  • Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems (ECC) to S/4HANA.
  • Participate in mock conversions, data loads, reconciliations, and cutover readiness.
  • Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to go-live.

Data Governance & Standards

  • Support establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.
  • Collaborate with Master Data and Data Governance teams.
  • Help define data ownership, stewardship, and governance models.
  • Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

  • Support functional and integrated testing with strong focus on data accuracy.
  • Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.
  • Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.
  • Provide post-go-live stabilization and hypercare support.


Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield implementations preferred).
  • Proven experience in large-scale, global ERP transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of value stream processes and related data objects.
  • Solid background in data migration, cleansing, conversion, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (Material, Vendor/Business Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).
  • Understanding of ECC to S/4HANA data model changes.
  • Experience with master data management and governance concepts.
  • Familiarity with data migration tools (SAP Migration Cockpit, ETL tools, LVM).
  • Ability to interpret functional specifications, data models, and technical table structures.
  • Experience with enterprise asset hierarchies and master data modeling.
  • Master data and indirect materials experience required.
  • Profisee Software experience required.
  • Experience with Promethius Asset Workbench is highly desirable (not mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.
  • Prior experience as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.
  • Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.
  • Knowledge of data quality tools, metrics, and governance frameworks.

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.
